hero.headline: Garage Door Track Repair in Chicago & Chicagoland
hero.subheadline: We service all residential garage door track systems.

intro: A garage door track guides your door's movement. These tracks ensure the door opens and closes smoothly. They keep rollers in place. Tracks typically run vertically and horizontally along the garage walls. A damaged track prevents proper door operation. In Chicago's city garages, alley traffic or tight spaces can cause track damage. Suburban attached garages might see track issues from vehicle impact or loose hardware. A compromised track can cause the door to bind, stick, or even come off its hinges. This creates a safety risk. Our technicians identify the exact cause of track failure. We repair or replace damaged sections. We restore safe and reliable garage door function for homeowners across Chicagoland. We work on all residential garage door types. We service single-car and multi-car garage doors. This includes overhead doors common in bungalows and larger suburban homes.
whatWeDo: We repair or replace damaged garage door tracks. Track issues often stem from bent metal, loose mounting hardware, or vehicle impact. A proper repair involves assessing the entire track system. We check for misalignments, dents, and obstructions. Minor bends may allow for careful straightening. Severely damaged sections require full replacement. We install new vertical and horizontal track sections. We also replace worn or damaged track brackets and jamb fasteners. These components secure the track to the door frame. Flag brackets, which connect vertical and horizontal sections, are also replaced if damaged. Our service includes adjusting track alignment for smooth operation. We use heavy-gauge steel replacement parts. This ensures durability. The cost, typically $130–$400, depends on the number of sections needing replacement. A single bent vertical section costs less than replacing multiple horizontal track pieces across a wider door. We always provide an upfront flat-rate quote.

problemSigns.detail: The garage door stops or struggles to move at the same point during opening or closing. This indicates an obstruction or misalignment in the track at that specific spot.
You can see physical damage to the metal track itself. This damage prevents rollers from moving freely.
Rollers detach from the track channels. This can happen if the track is too wide, bent, or if the door is misaligned.

problemSigns.sign: Gap between track and door frame
problemSigns.detail: The track pulls away from the garage door frame. Loose mounting brackets or fasteners typically cause this.
Unusual sounds during door operation often point to friction caused by misaligned or damaged tracks.

process.description: Our technician inspects the entire garage door system. We identify the specific track damage and its cause. We then provide an upfront flat-rate quote for the repair before any work begins.
We straighten minor track bends or replace severely damaged vertical, horizontal, or flag sections. Our trucks are stocked with common parts. This allows for same-day repairs in most cases.
We carefully align the new or repaired track sections. We ensure proper spacing and smooth roller movement. We secure all track brackets and fasteners.
After the repair, we perform a balance test on the door. We also conduct a safety-reverse test. This confirms the garage door operates safely and correctly.

faqs.q: What causes garage door tracks to bend?
faqs.a: Garage door tracks can bend for several reasons. Vehicle impact is a common cause, especially in tight city garages or busy suburban driveways. Age and wear can also loosen mounting hardware, causing the track to pull away from the wall. If rollers seize, they can put excessive stress on the track, leading to bending or misalignment. Sometimes, an improperly balanced door can also exert uneven force, deforming the track over time. Regular maintenance can help identify and prevent these issues.

faqs.q: How much does garage door track repair cost?
faqs.a: The cost for garage door track repair typically ranges from $130 to $400. This price depends on the extent of the damage and the number of track sections that need replacement. A minor realignment or a single bent vertical section will be at the lower end of the range. Replacing multiple horizontal sections or more complex repairs involving multiple brackets will be at the higher end. We provide an upfront flat-rate quote after diagnosing the specific issue.

faqs.q: Can I repair a bent garage door track myself?
faqs.a: Repairing a bent garage door track is complex. It requires specific tools and experience to ensure proper alignment and safety. Misaligned tracks can cause the door to jump off its rollers or fall, creating a serious safety hazard. We recommend professional repair for track issues. Our technicians are trained to handle these repairs safely and effectively. They ensure the entire system functions correctly.

faqs.q: Is track repair considered an emergency service?
faqs.a: Yes, track repair can be an emergency service. If your garage door is stuck open, off its tracks, or poses a safety risk, it's an emergency. We offer 24-hour dispatch Monday through Saturday for urgent repairs. A damaged track can prevent your garage door from securing your home or vehicle. Prompt repair is important for security and safety.

faqs.q: How long does a track repair take?
faqs.a: Most garage door track repairs can be completed in under two hours. The exact time depends on the severity of the damage and the number of sections needing replacement. Our technicians arrive with common parts stocked on their trucks. This helps us complete repairs efficiently during the initial visit. More extensive damage, such as a complete track system overhaul, might take longer.
